jobs.title: Core Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare systems/operations match spanning payer workflows, provider setup, claims, benefits configuration, vendor performance, Jira/ServiceNow tracking, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination. Strong overlap with healthcare operations, workflow design, troubleshooting, and systems implementation.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 5–7 years specifically in healthcare payer systems, including claims processing, benefit configuration, provider data management, and systems testing/migration. Emphasize managed-care workflow exposure and systems/process ownership without overstating payer-platform depth.

jobs.title: Manager, Provider Relations (Metro, NY)
jobs.location: New York, NY · Metro NY / field-based
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare operations fit involving provider relationships, claims and credentialing issues, provider data, reimbursement, operational analytics, root-cause problem solving, escalations, and cross-functional work with Network Management, Claims, Medical Management, Finance, and Contracting.
jobs.gap: Direct provider-relations and payer/network experience are preferred. The salary band is broad, so confirm likely New York offer range early and lead with intake, authorization, provider/family communication, healthcare operations, issue resolution, and reporting experience.

jobs.title: Consumer Onboarding Strategy Execution Lead
jobs.why: Strong healthcare transformation and onboarding fit centered on member experience, integrated delivery plans, cross-functional workstreams, governance, readiness, KPI tracking, change management, pilots, and implementation. The onboarding and workflow-transformation focus maps well to healthcare operations and systems work.
jobs.gap: This is a lead-level role and may favor deeper enterprise transformation tenure. Emphasize end-to-end onboarding, process design, automation, stakeholder coordination, training, reporting, and implementation ownership while keeping tenure claims precise.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare SaaS implementation match with executive, operational, clinical, and technical stakeholders, project ownership, problem solving, remote teamwork, and client implementation. Healthcare workflow and stakeholder-management experience translate well.
jobs.gap: Arcadia may expect deeper enterprise healthcare data and implementation experience. Emphasize healthcare workflows, onboarding, training, documentation, troubleshooting, and cross-functional execution without overstating integration expertise.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategic Planning & Operations
jobs.why: High-upside healthcare operations/strategy role focused on operating rhythms, cross-functional execution, dashboards, KPI tracking, governance, reporting, AI-enabled workflow improvement, and turning business priorities into actionable plans. Strong conceptual overlap with systems/process operations and reporting work.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch requiring 7+ years plus experience with enterprise planning cycles and BI tools such as Power BI/Tableau/Domo. Present reporting/dashboard experience accurately and do not overstate tenure or BI depth.

jobs.title: Manager of Provider Contract Configuration
jobs.why: Strong payer operations and systems role involving process improvement, provider contracting, credentialing, claims, utilization management, network management, requirements, QA/UAT, systems implementation, vendor coordination, and payment-process improvement.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 10 years of healthcare systems experience or an equivalent combination of education/training/experience. Treat as a stretch and focus on relevant healthcare workflows, authorization exposure, testing, documentation, systems troubleshooting, and implementation work.

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong health-tech enterprise implementation role with complex customer programs, healthcare stakeholders, data integrations, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional project execution. It aligns with implementation, healthcare workflow, onboarding, and systems-coordination strengths.
jobs.gap: Enterprise healthcare data integrations and executive client-management depth are likely stronger requirements than the current profile. Position systems/project ownership and healthcare operations clearly while staying precise about integration depth.

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign Operations Strategist
jobs.why: Healthcare marketing-operations role centered on workflow automation, Salesforce CRM data quality, campaign operations, QA, reporting, troubleshooting, process standardization, lifecycle programs, and cross-functional execution. It leverages marketing background without making SEO the core responsibility.
jobs.gap: Hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot is required and is a meaningful gap. Apply only as a stretch and emphasize CRM/process automation, QA, reporting, campaign operations, and troubleshooting without claiming Pardot expertise.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Product Project Manager - Hybrid/Remote
jobs.why: Healthcare project-management role involving cross-functional execution, product development, operations coordination, risk management, communication, and strategic planning within a New York health plan. The project/process side is transferable.
jobs.gap: The role requires strong pharmaceutical market, GMP/GCP, FDA/EMA, and product-lifecycle expertise, which are substantial domain gaps. Treat this as a stretch and lead with healthcare operations/project execution rather than implying pharmacy-regulatory experience.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare AI implementation match covering customer onboarding, weekly status calls, training, technical troubleshooting, multi-project execution, process improvement, cross-functional work with clinical/AI/engineering teams, and go-live readiness.
jobs.gap: The salary only reaches the $100K threshold, and the role includes hardware/networking implementation plus up to 25% travel. Emphasize training, implementation, troubleshooting, process improvement, and healthcare operations while being clear about hardware depth.
